title: Useful computation depends on data movement
caption: Capacity, bandwidth and latency answer different questions. Storage holding a dataset does not guarantee fast delivery to the arithmetic units.

nodes.label: Storage
nodes.detail: Holds information beyond the immediate working set.

nodes.label: Working memory
nodes.detail: Supplies data needed by active computations.

nodes.label: Compute
nodes.detail: Uses inputs and produces results.

edges.label: load data into the working set

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: A DRAM read senses and restores a small charge
caption: The selected cell shares charge with the bit line. The sense amplifier resolves the small signal and restores the value while the cell remains connected.

nodes.label: Cell capacitor
nodes.detail: Stores the bit as a small charge.

nodes.label: Access transistor
nodes.detail: A selected word line connects the cell.

nodes.label: Bit line
nodes.detail: Carries the small voltage change.

nodes.label: Sense amplifier
nodes.detail: Resolves and restores the electrical state.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Retained charge changes a NAND cell’s threshold
caption: The stored information is inferred from transistor behavior. The storage region is electrically isolated rather than connected like a DRAM capacitor.

nodes.label: Program
nodes.detail: Place charge in the storage region.

nodes.label: Retain
nodes.detail: Electrical isolation helps preserve charge without power.

nodes.label: Read
nodes.detail: Determine which threshold range the cell occupies.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Two different ways of building memory upward
caption: 3D NAND builds cells through deposited layers around vertical channels. HBM connects separately fabricated DRAM dies into a stack.

nodes.label: 3D NAND
nodes.detail: A vertical channel passes through multiple cell layers.

nodes.label: HBM
nodes.detail: TSVs and joints connect distinct DRAM dies.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: An HBM stack connects down to the package
caption: TSVs and joints link the thinned dies. The base provides interfaces to the fine wiring that connects memory to the neighboring processor.

nodes.label: DRAM dies
nodes.detail: Several separately fabricated memory dies form the stack.

nodes.label: Base die
nodes.detail: Supports stack interfaces and test access.

nodes.label: Fine wiring
nodes.detail: Connects the HBM stack and neighboring GPU.

nodes.label: Substrate
nodes.detail: Redistributes connections toward the board.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Screen at the die, stack and package stages
caption: Undetected die defects and assembly defects can both reduce useful output. A tested stack still needs evaluation in its final package context.

nodes.label: Incoming dies
nodes.detail: Screen before committing them to a stack.

nodes.label: Stack assembly
nodes.detail: Create vertical connections between the dies.

nodes.label: Stack test
nodes.detail: Exercise memory through available internal access.

nodes.label: GPU integration
nodes.detail: Check the stack with the package and cooling conditions.
